task: Phase 04 (F003 Kudos authoring): kudos schema + constraints, create/update Server Actions with outbox, image upload signing, Sunner search, hashtag list, edit prefill route, and the Write Kudo composer modal for the SAA 2025 Kudos platform
acceptanceCriteria: new kudo is public with session sender, 1-5 hashtags, ordered images and exactly one KudoCreated outbox row; failure after insert rolls back both
self-send rejected by action and by DB CHECK; second kudo to same recipient succeeds
over-length body, 0 or 6 hashtags, inactive hashtag, 6 images, foreign or unknown upload path are rejected server-side with no rows written
non-owner update 403 and spam update 423 leave the row unchanged; recipient and created_at immutable
after EVENT_END_AT create and update return WRITING_CLOSED and the launcher is disabled
no route or action deletes a kudo
Sunner search is diacritic-insensitive, honours excludeSelf, treats LIKE metachars literally and answers 401 without session
title optional up to 50 chars; Markdown subset body up to 1,000 raw chars, no HTML, no images, no reference-style links
anonymous kudo requires a 1-30 char nickname enforced by CHECK
missing required fields show the DEC-001 message verbatim
pending uploads capped at 20 per user per 24h (429 UPLOAD_LIMIT); sign body capped at 4 KB (413)
composer modal matches Figma on desktop and mobile; double submit creates one kudo
blastRadius: phase 05 feed reads kudos and renders the Markdown body and anonymous nickname
phases 06/09/10 count over kudos; phase 08 adds moderation transitions
phase 12 reuses the locked-recipient composer and search; phase 13 consumes KudoCreated outbox rows
kudo-images Storage bucket objects referenced from kudo_images
contracts: createKudoAction/updateKudoAction return KudoWriteResult with error codes (MISSING_REQUIRED, WRITING_CLOSED, FORBIDDEN 403, LOCKED 423, PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE 413, UPLOAD_LIMIT 429)
sender_id only from session; status never accepted from client
phase 05 renderer whitelist pinned in research/phase-04-backend-contracts.md section 1.1
